description: This file contains the implementation of a Data Access Object (DAO) for serialized objects in the OpenMRS project, specifically using Hibernate for database interactions. It provides methods for CRUD operations, serialization/deserialization, and type registration for serialized OpenMRS objects.

classes.name: HibernateSerializedObjectDAO
classes.description: A Hibernate-based implementation of the SerializedObjectDAO interface for handling serialized OpenMRS objects, incorporating singleton pattern and type registration mechanisms.

methods.name: getSerializedObject
methods.description: Retrieves a serialized object by its ID.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenMRS object of a specific class by serialized object ID.

methods.name: getSerializedObjectByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a serialized object from the database by its UUID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenMRS object by its UUID and class type.

methods.name: getAllSerializedObjectsByName
methods.description: Returns a list of serialized objects matching a given name and type, with an option for exact or partial match.

methods.name: getAllObjectsByName
methods.description: Returns a list of deserialized OpenMRS objects matching a given name and type.

methods.name: getAllSerializedObjects
methods.description: Fetches all serialized objects of a certain type, with an option to include or exclude retired objects.

methods.name: getAllObjects
methods.description: Returns all deserialized OpenMRS objects of a specified type, considering retirement status.

methods.name: saveObject
methods.description: Serializes and saves an OpenMRS object to the database.

methods.name: saveObject
methods.description: Serializes and saves an OpenMRS object with a specified serializer.

methods.name: purgeObject
methods.description: Deletes a serialized object from the database by its ID.

methods.name: registerSupportedType
methods.description: Registers a class type as supported for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: unregisterSupportedType
methods.description: Unregisters a class type, making it unsupported for serialization.

methods.name: getRegisteredTypeForObject
methods.description: Returns the registered class type for a given OpenMRS object.

methods.name: convertSerializedObject
methods.description: Deserializes a SerializedObject into an OpenMRS object of a specified class.
